name: dathon-vscode
description: Static schema checking for PySpark — diagnostics, hover, completion, go-to-definition, and quick-fixes for .dpy files. Pairs with any Python LSP (basedpyright / Pylance / ruff-lsp) for general Python features.

dathon.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the dathon-lsp binary. If empty, the extension searches the workspace's target/release and target/debug directories, then falls back to 'dathon-lsp' on PATH.

dathon.pythonServer.path.description: Absolute path to a Python language server (basedpyright-langserver / pyright-langserver) for dathon-lsp to embed for general Python features. If empty, the basedpyright bundled with this extension is used (requires Node.js on PATH). dathon's schema features work regardless.

dathon.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication between the editor and dathon-lsp.
